title.suggested: Tom Allen Advises Peter Maher at Maher-Choynski Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Tom Allen returned from New York, where he sat ringside as an adviser to Peter Maher in his win over Joe Choynski at Tom O'Rourke's Broadway Club.
